hints.title: Consecutive Value Boundary
hints.text: Consecutive integers differ by exactly one in a sorted list without duplicates. How can a moving boundary identify when a contiguous sequence breaks?

hints.title: Range Extension Condition
hints.text: For each starting position, advance the inner index while the next element equals the current element plus one. Format as a single number or a range based on span.

hints.title: Pointer Advancement Formatting Procedure
hints.text: Iterate with an index pointer through the array. For each range start, increment a pointer while adjacent elements differ by one. If the start equals the end, append the single number string; otherwise append start arrow end. Advance to the next unexplored position.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Rebuilding or sorting already sorted inputs creates unnecessary overhead; handling the final range requires careful boundary guards.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: A single linear scan processes each number in O(N) time with O(1) auxiliary space beyond the output array.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should handle empty inputs cleanly, format single elements without arrows, and avoid index out of bounds.
